5016.title: Codex transcription request budget mismatch
5016.rootCauseOneLine: Codex imposes a 10-second request deadline and 11-second host RPC deadline beneath core's 70-second voice budget.
5016.proposedFix: Use the existing 65-second transcription budget, retaining one second of host RPC grace beneath core's 70-second limit.
5016.caveats: Deterministic real-service/real-client reproduction with synthetic credentials and delayed HTTP; no live audio-duration, network, or transcript-completeness claims were verified.
